mapper.select: SELECT h.id AS household_id, p.id AS preferences_id, p.recipe_public, p.recipe_show_nutrition, p.recipe_show_assets, p.recipe_landscape_view, p.recipe_disable_comments FROM users u JOIN households h ON h.id = u.household_id AND h.group_id = u.group_id LEFT JOIN household_preferences p ON p.household_id = h.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.group_id = #{groupId} AND h.id = #{householdId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipes (id, slug, group_id, user_id, name, name_normalized, description, description_normalized, recipe_servings, recipe_yield_quantity, date_added, date_updated, created_at, update_at, is_ocr_recipe) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{slug}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{nameNormalized}, '', '', 0, 0, #{dateAdded}, #{timestamp}, #{timestamp}, #{timestamp}, #{no})

INSERT INTO recipes_ingredients (recipe_id, position, quantity, note, note_normalized, reference_id, created_at, update_at) VALUES (#{recipeId}, 0, 0, #{ingredientNote}, #{ingredientNormalized}, #{referenceId}, #{timestamp}, #{timestamp})

INSERT INTO recipe_instructions (id, recipe_id, position, type, title, summary, text, created_at, update_at) VALUES (#{instructionId}, #{recipeId}, 0, '', '', '', #{instructionText}, #{timestamp}, #{timestamp})
INSERT INTO recipe_nutrition (recipe_id, created_at, update_at) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{timestamp}, #{timestamp})

INSERT INTO recipe_settings (recipe_id, public, show_nutrition, show_assets, landscape_view, disable_comments, locked, disable_amount, created_at, update_at) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{public}, #{showNutrition}, #{showAssets}, #{landscapeView}, #{disableComments}, #{no}, #{yes}, #{timestamp}, #{timestamp})

INSERT INTO recipe_timeline_events (id, recipe_id, user_id, subject, event_type, image, timestamp, created_at, update_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{recipeId}, #{userId}, 'recipe.recipe-created', 'system', 'does not have image', #{timestamp}, #{timelineTimestamp}, #{timelineTimestamp})
